question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Delhi by the Election Commission of India? (February 2026)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashok Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Election Commission of India has appointed IAS officer Ashok Kumar as the new Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Ashok Kumar will assume charge immediately as CEO of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi.**
 
• He replaces R Alice Vaz in the post.
 
• The Election Commission had sought a panel of three IAS officers from the Delhi government in January.
 
• Ashok Kumar was among the three names recommended to the Election Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Chief Electoral Officer (CEO)__

 __
 
• The CEO is appointed by the Election Commission of India in consultation with the State/UT government.
 
• The officer supervises election work in the State or Union Territory.
 
• The CEO coordinates with District Election Officers and Returning Officers for conduct of elections.
 
 
 
• Election Commission of India (ECI)__
 
 
• A constitutional body established under Article 324 of the Constitution of India.
 
• Responsible for conducting elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President.
